{
  "dataset_name": "ailerons",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "climb_rate_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of the climbRate feature to provide a scaled input suitable for linear SVM margins.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves convergence and margin scaling for linear models by centering and standardizing a high-variance feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(climbRate + 10.953) / 257.114"
    },
    {
      "name": "sgz_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalization of the Sgz feature.",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures the Sgz feature contributes proportionally to the SVM decision boundary without dominating due to its scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Sgz + 12.92) / 25.146"
    },
    {
      "name": "pitch_roll_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cross-product of current pitch and current roll to capture non-linear aerodynamic interactions in a linear-friendly format.",
      "value_range": [-10.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to model the synergistic effects of pitch and roll without requiring a non-linear kernel.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "curPitch * curRoll"
    },
    {
      "name": "abs_roll_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of absRoll from its mean, capturing the magnitude of roll extremity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous severity measure of roll deviation, which is highly effective for margin-based classifiers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(absRoll + 11.029)"
    },
    {
      "name": "dynamic_pressure_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proxy for dynamic pressure or aerodynamic force by multiplying the absolute values of pitch rate (q) and Sgz.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a physically meaningful composite feature that linearly correlates with aerodynamic stress.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(q) * np.abs(Sgz)"
    },
    {
      "name": "alpha_pitch_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of angle of attack (alpha) to current pitch, with a small constant added to the denominator to prevent division by zero.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights discrepancies between the angle of attack and the actual pitch, providing a strong linear signal for flight envelope boundaries.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "alpha / (np.abs(curPitch) + 0.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "roll_rate_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the absolute values of roll rate (p) and differential roll rate, representing the total roll volatility.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates roll rate metrics into a single continuous severity score, simplifying the feature space for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(p) + np.abs(diffRollRate)"
    },
    {
      "name": "climb_acceleration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of the first and second differences of climb rate, representing the overall acceleration in the vertical plane.",
      "value_range": [-50.0, 55.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines derivative terms into a single momentum feature, providing a smoother signal for the linear decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "diffClb + diffDiffClb"
    },
    {
      "name": "extreme_climb_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses whether the climb rate and its derivatives indicate an extreme or unstable maneuver, returning a continuous severity score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates complex, multi-variable thresholds into a single continuous risk score that a linear model can easily weight.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "aerodynamic_instability_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Evaluates the combination of pitch, roll, and their respective rates to determine the overall level of aerodynamic instability.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, expert-like evaluation of flight stability, reducing the burden on the linear model to learn complex interactions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "control_surface_stress",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Estimates the mechanical stress on control surfaces based on the magnitude of Sgz, p, and q.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a proxy for physical strain, offering a distinct, linearly separable dimension related to aircraft limits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "sensor_noise_level",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Measures the aggregate noise or jitter across the diffSeTime variables to identify potentially unreliable sensor readings.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the model to down-weight or adjust its confidence for rows with high sensor noise, improving overall robustness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
